ROOT.viewdef: CREATE VIEW CDN.Rozrachunki ( ROZ_GIDTyp, ROZ_GIDFirma, ROZ_GIDNumer, ROZ_GIDLp, ROZ_TrpTyp, ROZ_TrpFirma, ROZ_TrpNumer, ROZ_TrpLp, ROZ_KAZTyp, ROZ_KAZFirma, ROZ_KAZNumer, ROZ_KAZLp, R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dok2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dok2Numer END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dok2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dok2Lp END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 432 END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret1Numer END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret1Lp END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 432 END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret2Numer END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret2Lp END, R2_KwotaWal1, R2_KwotaSys, 0, 0, R2_Waluta1, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret1DC END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret2DC END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRL,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 128 END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRL,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRL,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_OpeNumerRL END, 0, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRZ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 128 END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRZ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRZ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_OpeNumerRZ END, 0, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_RK,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_RK END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_RKStrona,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_RKStrona END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_DataRozliczenia,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_DataRozliczenia END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_DataRozrachunku,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_DataRozrachunku END, R2_ParID, R2_Wycena FROM CDN.Rozliczenia WHERE R2_Wycena ISNULL(R2_Dok2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dok2Numer END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dok2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dok2Lp END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dok1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dok1Typ END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dok1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dok1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dok1Numer END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dok1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dok1Lp END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret2Lp END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 432 END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret1Numer END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret1Lp END, R2_KwotaWal2, R2_KwotaSys, 0, 0, R2_Waluta2, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret2Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret2DC END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_Dekret1Numer,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_Dekret1DC END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRL,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 128 END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRL,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_GIDFirma END, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRL,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE R2_OpeNumerRL END, 0, CASE WHEN ISNULL(R2_OpeNumerRZ,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 128 END, CASE WHEN R2_DataRozrachunku END, R2_ParID, R2_Wycena FROM CDN.Rozliczenia WHERE R2_Wycena = 0
